scientific_integrity: Proved analytically with a reproducible exact rational computation; no independent verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the alternating function at r=3. The finite exact rational certificate establishes 32 interval-block comparisons; the infinite tail uses Nagura's prime-interval theorem. The 19 component endpoints and their union are proved, but component densities and other real parameters are not.
title: Nineteen components of the alternating reciprocal-cube divisor-sum range
